layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no good entries right now, patience is the play.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood (27/100 on the Fear & Greed Index) and has been stuck there all week. Bitcoin is down about 2% over seven days, and altcoins are getting hit even harder — most candidates are in clear downtrends with bearish chart patterns. A major Bitcoin cold-wallet hack worth $70-89 million is spooking investors, and Bitcoin ETFs just saw $265 million in outflows. This is not the time to catch falling knives.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is scared and trending down. Better entry prices are likely coming, or at minimum we need to see fear stabilize and a clear reversal signal before committing money.
expert_reasoning: Reviewing all seven candidates systematically: KAITO has RSI 87 (extremely overbought, high correction risk despite bullish chart — chasing here violates risk management). BONK has RSI 29 (oversold, our most reliable signal) but the chart bias is -1.4 with bearish engulfing pattern and -26.5% 5-day momentum — this is a falling knife, not a bounce setup. ENA has a strongly bearish chart (-1.7 bias) with an evening star reversal despite today's 8% pop. FET and LDO are both in downtrends below all MAs with bearish patterns. TRUMP and PEPE lack chart data entirely. The Fear & Greed Index at 27 with a worsening trend, combined with BTC dominance at 56.2% (unfavorable for alts), and negative news flow (Coldcard hack, ETF outflows, mining difficulty drop) all argue against opening new positions. Per my validated rules, F&G near 25 in ambiguous territory warrants HOLD over forced entries.
risk_factors: The Coldcard hack ($70-89M in losses) could escalate further, eroding trust and triggering more selling
Bitcoin ETF outflows of $265M signal institutional risk-off behavior that could accelerate
Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening trend could slide toward extreme fear (<20), pushing prices significantly lower
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for a drop below 25 (extreme fear capitulation) or stabilization above 30 (potential bottom forming)
BONK RSI — if it drops below 25 while showing a bullish divergence or hammer candle on support, that would be an actionable oversold bounce setup
Bitcoin ETF flow data over next 48 hours — continued outflows = more downside; a reversal to inflows = potential market bottom signal
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven downturn with BTC at $63,163 and most alts bleeding harder. Negative catalysts (Coldcard hack, ETF outflows, mining difficulty collapse) are dominating headlines with no offsetting bullish drivers, though ADA's +12.5% weekly gain is a notable exception worth monitoring.
context_banner: Market fear is elevated and worsening with no clear reversal signals — disciplined traders stay in cash and wait for better setups.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening weekly trend — market is fearful but not yet at extreme capitulation levels, suggesting more downside is possible before a bottom forms.
KAITO RSI at 87 (extremely overbought, avoid) and BONK RSI at 29 (oversold but chart structure is too bearish to buy) — no candidate has a clean RSI-based setup.
Coldcard Bitcoin hack estimated at $70M+ is the largest sub-1 BTC theft since FTX collapse, creating significant negative sentiment overhang.
Bitcoin ETFs bled $265M in 24 hours, signaling institutional risk-off positioning that typically precedes further price weakness.
Bitcoin mining difficulty dropped 14% from yearly highs as operators pivot away from mining — a sign of network stress and reduced confidence in near-term BTC profitability.
